verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents a SOC 2 control mapping into its Unified Controls, policy creation with an approval-gated publishing workflow, and evidence requests tied to audits handled in one platform from scoping through final report. Nothing in the evidence explicitly addresses running Type I versus Type II engagements, and the Trust Services Criteria are not named. Missing for 10: explicit Type I and Type II audit support, explicit Trust Services Criteria coverage, SOC 2-specific required policy templates, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can run a SOC 2 program end to end — Type I and Type II — with the Trust Services controls, required policies, and evidence requests built into the platform

citations.quote: If you're used to working with a specific SOC 2 framework control, you can use this guide to identify its corresponding Unified Control.
Create policies in minutes and prep for your audit in no time.
The new workflow requires a separate Approver's sign-off before any policy is published.
List evidence requests, view their details, and see the systems tied to them
High-quality data automatically satisfies evidence requests while powering transparent continuous compliance monitors.
From scoping through final report, every step happens in one platform
